authority.source: User direction to complete the dual-loop mainline while allowing a route change

scope.goal: Implement the target/frame-bound second-loop input seam, fail-closed admission, and a single non-actuating production shadow path.

required_identity: allowlisted source contract and source id pair
class, label, box, frame size and detection source
required_time: current frame exactly equals the decision source frame
previous frame precedes current frame in the same source, coordinate frame and clock domain
availability, current frame and decision timestamps share an explicitly bound comparable clock domain
available_at is not in the future
required_measurement: finite quality at or above the frozen 0.50 engineering gate
fail_closed: clock-domain mismatch or unmapped camera clock

required: admitted shadow evidence cannot mutate risk, event, feedback or trace
baseline and shadow decisions remain frame-exact
core, feature and app unit tests pass
debug baseline and isolated shadow builds assemble

claim_ceiling: Engineering wiring, identity, time, abstention and non-actuation behavior only. No D0 priority, geometry accuracy, alert improvement, effectiveness, confirmation, product or safety claim.
